context_requirements: Active HIV reverse transcriptase or other retroviral polymerase for canonical antiviral activity
High telomerase activity and TERT dependence for potential telomerase inhibition
Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (PNP) dependence for PNP-mediated effects
Concentrations sufficient to inhibit non-retroviral targets such as TERT or PNP
falsifiers: Reproducible transcriptional changes in any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Dose-dependent changes in TERT or PNP target genes
Induction of generic stress, apoptosis, or interferon programs
